items.name: Metformin (二甲雙胍)
items.instructions: Take with breakfast and dinner. 早餐及晚餐時服用。
items.storage_note: Store below 25°C in a dry place. 存放於攝氏25度以下乾爽處。

items.name: Amlodipine (氨氯地平)
items.instructions: Take once a day in the morning. 每朝服用一次。
items.storage_note: Keep in a cool dry place, away from sunlight. 存放於陰涼乾爽處，避免陽光直射。

items.name: Aspirin low dose (低劑量阿士匹靈)
items.instructions: Take after breakfast. 早餐後服用。
items.storage_note: Keep in the original box, in a dry place. 保留在原裝盒內，存放於乾爽處。
